desc: Ideation: identify that target.length <= 4 enables mask DP; identify flaw in naive partition DP (same element double-counted, e.g., nums=[6], target=[4,9] gives wrong 5 instead of 30); settle on element-wise DP O(n * 3^k)
Implement LCM precomputation for all 2^k masks (k<=4) using math.gcd / math.lcm
Implement per-element cost computation: c[mask] = (-x) % lcm[mask] for all non-empty masks
Implement element-wise subset DP: snapshot dp per element, for each mask iterate submasks, new_dp[mask] = min(dp[mask^sub] + c[sub]); return dp[full]
Verify against three given examples (1, 2, 0) and counterexample nums=[6], target=[4,9] → 30; add small random brute-force cross-check if feasible
Write final solution in starter code format with `from typing import List` and `import math`, with micro-optimizations (precomputed submask iteration, local variables)
